conversation.user: Which team member focuses on conflict resolution and global governance?
conversation.assistant:
Stacy D. VanDeveer and Maria H. Ivanova focus on conflict resolution and global governance: * **Stacy D. VanDeveer** serves as the Professor and Chair of the Department of Conflict Resolution, Human Security, and Global Governance at the McCormack Graduate School [1].
